$comment: Sizes are world pixels (320 x 180 view). Painted files are 4x. See content/README.md. The limestone, rock and sediment tiles are shared with Cap Blanc: same stone, same art, declared once in that level's manifest.

assets.what: The gate across the path to the shelter. Shut since the site was classified in 1955, and the tourist walks straight past it.
An ibex of the frieze, facing right, back level. Eight of them on the real wall: the commonest animal here.
A horse of the frieze, facing right, mane up, head carried low. Seven of them on the real wall.
A bison of the frieze, facing right, the hump standing above the line of the back. Six of them on the real wall.
One horn of the confronting pair, reaching in from the left with the tip at the right-hand end. Ridged the whole way.
A block of the roof fall lying in the river margin with its carved face turned under. The bedding plane is what you see.
One of the women of the frieze, carved from the waist to the knees. No head, no feet, no arms.
